name: Counter 3-4-1-2

slots.why: Wide centre-back who defends the channel. Cover is the alternate.
Ball-playing defender in the centre starts counters with a forward pass.
Cover centre-back sweeps up behind his partner and the wing-back's space; Defend is the alternate, but only one Cover can be used.
Support wing-back gives width but holds a safer position on this side.
Attacking wing-back is the team's main wide threat when the ball is won.
Defensive central midfielder screens the back three and lets his partner go forward.
Box-to-box midfielder supports the counter with runs from deep.
Attacking midfielder is the link between the midfield and two strikers, receiving between the lines.
Deep-lying forward (or Complete Forward) holds up the ball so others can join the counter.
Advanced Forward runs in behind the defence. Poacher is the alternate.

description: A cautious back-three system retaining an AMC and two strikers so regains can become attacks without waiting for many players to advance.
whyGood: The AMC, DLF and AF form an immediate counter-attacking triangle while the back three protect against turnovers.
whyThisShape: A back three, wing-backs, two central midfielders and an attacking midfielder behind two strikers. It defends with five or six players, then breaks quickly through the two forwards and the attacking midfielder.
whenToUse: Against stronger sides that will have most of the ball, or when your squad has quick forwards and dependable centre-backs.
whenNotToUse: When you need to dominate the game, or when your wing-backs cannot defend as well as they run.

instructionRationale.Slightly More Direct Passing: Gets the ball forward to the strikers quicker after winning it.
instructionRationale.Pass Into Space: Plays the ball into the space behind the opposition defence for the runners.
instructionRationale.Regroup: Drops back into shape after losing the ball; the shape has to be compact before the counter.
instructionRationale.Lower Line of Engagement: Lets the opponent have the ball in their own half and closes the space deeper, leaving space behind them to attack.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: A balanced line keeps the back three compact without leaving space in behind.
